_about: Questions and answers verbatim from the homepage FAQ section (also published as FAQPage JSON-LD). Page-level FAQs are auto-extracted.

chunks.title: FAQ: How much does a website or software project cost?
chunks.text: Every business is different, so GURU AI does not publish fixed prices. Share your requirements on WhatsApp or through the contact form and the team sends a clear, custom quote, usually within 24 hours.

chunks.title: FAQ: How long does a typical project take?
chunks.text: A premium business website usually takes 1 to 3 weeks. Custom software, apps and automation projects are scoped individually: a realistic timeline is given before work starts, with honest updates throughout.

chunks.title: FAQ: Will my website work well on mobile?
chunks.text: Yes. Designs are mobile-first and tested on real phone, tablet and desktop sizes, with no broken layouts, no horizontal scrolling and fast loading even on 4G.

chunks.title: FAQ: Do you provide support after launch?
chunks.text: Yes. Every project includes post-launch support, and ongoing maintenance plans are available for updates, backups and improvements.

chunks.title: FAQ: Can you add AI to my existing website or business?
chunks.text: Yes. GURU AI can add chatbots, automation or smart features to what a business already has; a full rebuild is not required to benefit from AI.

chunks.title: FAQ: Where are you located and do you work remotely?
chunks.text: GURU AI is based in Pune, Maharashtra, and works with clients across India and internationally. It is remote-first: calls are scheduled around the client's time zone, updates happen in writing so nothing waits on a meeting, and projects can be previewed live from anywhere. No street address is published on the website.
